svg.title: Visual fidelity aggregation
svg.desc: Surface precision and recall form the shape F-score. Supported material property matches are averaged first within each area sample and then across reference samples. Visual fidelity is the geometric mean of shape and appearance. Inapplicable factors are omitted and unmeasured active factors keep the scalar score unknown.

g.text: Match requires spatial and property tolerances
Equal weight per reference area sample
Assigned samples with no supported properties stay unmeasured.
Any active factor unmeasured: score unmeasured, with bounds.
Omit inapplicable factors. One remains: its score is used.
